name: lightZIG gen2
state: frozen. Named by 文豪 (2026-11-09) as the line that is grown as a fast, light model; for now it is the same network as beatZIG gen2 played as it is, with no reader.
what: The lightZIG line, generation 2: the same small network as beatZIG gen2 (features v4, one hidden layer of 32), no reader. Fast: the time of a move is the network and the game's own planner.

frozenCode.note: The CPU module imports only the copies in its own folder; cpus/learned/ and the others may change without changing how it plays. sha256 of each file with line endings read as LF; all = sha256 of the hashes in the order listed.

learnedFor.note: The rules the data was played under. When the game's rules change (the first-turn draw, a card, a rule version), the data and this CPU are of the old rules: learn it again.

learnedFrom: the same as beatZIG gen2 (see gen2/beatZIG.json): 2049 matches, 98,307 decisions recorded, 85,838 learned from; deep 294 matches, lookahead 735, lookahead-labelled student matches 980, Haiku 5.5 on 40 of them, 80 marks

evaluation.note: both seat orders, every pair of start decks, game b8214a6; 95% range: Wilson.
evaluation.checkAfterMove: 49 of 49 matches against beatZIG gen1 (seed 1, both orders) identical to the first measurement

timePerDecision.note: a guide: measured on a network of the same shape (the first one learned), a quiet machine, the CPU against itself; the cost of the forward pass is the same for the same shape and too small to see (timings of three networks differed by less than 0.3 ms in the mean)

keptAlso: a copy outside the repository: the weights file, the command that learned it, the marks and the arena results
